queries.question: why did glitch memory run at 3200 fclk
queries.rank1_summary: glitch's Threadripper 3960X runs 4x16 GB DDR4 at 3200 MT/s with FCLK 1600 because 3600 was unstable, and it has thrown 0 machine-check errors since.
queries.note: The fact lived only in a raw session blob's body until 2026-10-29, when it was written as its own entry (`0c0857e6`, evidence re-checked with lscpu + dmidecode over ssh). Before that the promoted hits were the OTHER box (3900X DOCP 3600, FCLK 1800) and a stale claim that glitch is a 3900X — both wrong for this machine and worse than a miss, because they read as authoritative.
